newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-TOSHACK UNDER FIRE AS TEMPERS FLARE AT DEPORTIVO.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-TOSHACK UNDER FIRE AS TEMPERS FLARE AT DEPORTIVO.

text.p: Brazilian midfielder Rivaldo remained upset with Deportivo Coruna manager John Toshack on Monday following his substition in Sunday's 2-2 home draw with Athletic Bilbao. Rivaldo avoided conversation with his beleaguered boss during morning training and said after the session: "Now I'm a bit more relaxed, but I'm still annoyed.,"
Toshack's decision to pull off Rivaldo was greeted with derision by Deportivo fans. The Welshman responded by swearing back at them.
Moroccan defender Noureddinne Naybet followed his manager's lead by answering barracking from the stands with an obscene gesture.
Deportivo chairman Augusto Lendoiro took the unusual step of speaking to both players and manager at halftime in a bid to calm the situation.
